title: Transcription Service Implementation
description: Gemini 1.5 Flash-based transcription service for call recordings. Supports Hindi, English, and Hinglish with automatic language detection. Handles both URL and local file inputs with proper error handling and timeout management.
features: Gemini 1.5 Flash API integration for audio transcription
Multi-language support (Hindi, English, Hinglish) with auto-detect
Accepts both URL and local file path inputs
Returns structured result: { text, language, confidence }
Error handling with detailed error messages
acceptance_criteria: Service can transcribe audio from Cloudinary URLs
Service can transcribe audio from local file paths
Handles errors gracefully (invalid files, API failures)
result_summary: Full transcription service implemented using Gemini 1.5 Flash model. Supports multiple input formats and languages. Integrated with call processing pipeline. Ready for production use with Android app backend.
